entries.wording: 快件电子信息已经收到 Shipment information received
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the order data. Scan texts give the Chinese wording, then the English one.
The same scan in English only, in the documentation's later tracking example.
In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the latest-event summary listed beside a parcel that has only its order data.

entries.wording: 快件到达作业中心 Shipment arrived at facility
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: HuaHan's operations centre in Shenzhen receiving the parcel, its first scan after the order data.
The same code in the documentation's later tracking example: HuaHan's warehouse in Shenzhen received the parcel.
The latest-event summary form of the arrival at HuaHan's operations centre, in the documentation's later tracking example.

entries.wording: 快件操作完成 Shipment departed from facility
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the parcel left HuaHan's operations centre in Shenzhen.
In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the latest-event summary form of the departure from the operations centre.
HuaHan's receipt at its origin facility in its English words, relayed by a tracking provider under the provider's own code: the wording gives the stage.
HuaHan's departure from its origin facility in its English words, relayed the same way.
Relayed by 17TRACK without a code, between the parcel's departures from the origin facility.
The parcel moving from the origin facility to the departure airport.
Export clearance at the origin, before the flight.
The flight leaving the origin.
Import clearance opening at the destination gateway.
The flight landing at the destination gateway.
Import clearance released, before the hand-off to the destination carrier.

entries.wording: Has been given to local carrier
entries.note: HuaHan handing the parcel to the destination carrier after import clearance; the partner's scans follow it.

entries.wording: We will pick up your parcel from the sender soon.
entries.note: The destination carrier's notice from its pre-advice, between the order data and HuaHan's receipt in Shenzhen.

entries.wording: Pendiente de recepción en CTT Express
entries.note: CTT Express's notice of the parcel coming, its own pre-advice wording (code 0000), relayed without a code hours before HuaHan's receipt in Shenzhen.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically.
entries.note: DHL's record of the sender's data for the last leg, relayed without a code, before HuaHan's receipt in China or after its departure from there: data, not a movement.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: The same record of DHL's, relayed without its full stop.

entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The order's electronic data received, in Chinese without a code; it can come after HuaHan's receipt in China.

entries.wording: The parcel was redirected. As soon as it is in the couriers possession, it will be processed as requested.
entries.note: The destination carrier's record of the recipient's redirection, written while the parcel was still in China: it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Ready to Ship, Parcel received and processed
entries.note: The destination carrier's receipt after the hand-off; HuaHan accepted the parcel in China.
Relayed without a code after the destination carrier's receipt.
The destination carrier's record of a new delivery address, relayed without a code after the hand-off; the parcel is still on its way.

entries.wording: The parcel is in the central warehouse waiting to be processed.
In Transit, Shipment arrived to sorting centre / Shipment in the sorting centre
The parcel is on the way to the local warehouse.
In Transit, Shipment remained at sorting hub
In Transit, Arrived to HU HUB
entries.note: The destination carrier's hub in Hungary, after its receipt.

entries.wording: In Transit, Parcel has entered the Linehaul network.
entries.note: The destination carrier's trunk route between its hubs, after the hub scan.
DPD's depot inbound scan (Einrollung) after the hand-off, not an acceptance: HuaHan accepted the parcel in China.

entries.wording: In Transit, Scanned By DPD At parcel delivery centre.
entries.note: DPD's depot scan after the hand-off, relayed under HuaHan's code, on each day the parcel waits there.

entries.wording: In Transit, At parcel delivery centre.
entries.note: The destination carrier's depot, after its depot scans.
DPD's attempt after its out-for-delivery, relayed without a code.

entries.wording: Delivery Attempted, Unfortunately we have not been able to deliver your parcel. Pickup parcelshop delivery after first delivery attempt.
entries.note: DPD's attempt, with the parcel going on to a pickup point.

entries.wording: Awaiting Pickup, Parcel was deposited in Pickup parcel station
entries.note: DPD left the parcel at a pickup point for its recipient after the attempt.

entries.wording: The courier will deliver the parcel soon. Additional details are available in the SAMEDAY app, email or SMS.
entries.note: The destination carrier's own words for the scan HuaHan codes CB, at the same instant.

entries.wording: Out for Delivery, Parcel is at courier, delivery expected soon.
entries.note: The destination carrier's courier scan, relayed under HuaHan's code.
The destination carrier's delivery, relayed under HuaHan's code with that carrier's wording.

entries.wording: The parcel has been successfully delivered.
entries.note: A second delivery wording from the same destination carrier under the same code.
The origin airport's receipt, after export clearance and before the departure from it.
Leaving the transfer warehouse, after the origin airport's receipt.

entries.wording: 快件从转运仓发出至机场，出口报关中（ The package is shipped from the transfer warehouse to the airport Export customs clearance in progress ）
entries.note: Export clearance under way, a routine step before the flight, not a hold.

entries.wording: 快件抵达机场，预计14号航班飞（The parcel has arrived at the airport and is currently being loaded onto a flight; it is scheduled to depart on 14 ）
entries.note: The day of the planned flight varies.

entries.wording: 航班延误，重新配载至15号航班飞（Flight delayed; rebooked onto flight 15）
entries.note: A delay, the parcel rebooked onto the day's flight it names.

entries.wording: 目的国清关完成 (Customs clearance in the destination country has been completed
entries.note: Import clearance done, before the hand-off to the destination carrier.
An American partner's scan relayed while the parcel was still in China, before its flight: written ahead, not the parcel's acceptance.
The same partner's scan, also before the flight.
The same partner's scan; the line goes on with its time and place.
China Post's receipt on HuaHan's postal line, after HuaHan's own acceptance: the hand-over to the post.

entries.wording: 邮件已在【…】完成分拣，准备发出
entries.note: China Post's scan on HuaHan's postal line, relayed in Chinese, with the office in 【】; read as China Post's map reads it.
China Post's scan on HuaHan's postal line, relayed in Chinese, with the offices in 【】; read as China Post's map reads it.
China Post's scan on HuaHan's postal line, relayed in Chinese: presented to export customs; read as China Post's map reads it.
China Post's scan on HuaHan's postal line, relayed in Chinese: export customs released it; read as China Post's map reads it.
China Post's scan on HuaHan's postal line, relayed in Chinese, with the office in 【】; read as China Post's map reads it.

entries.wording: 邮件离开【…】，正在发往下一站
entries.note: China Post's scan on HuaHan's postal line, relayed in Chinese, with the office in 【】; read as China Post's map reads it.
China Post's scan on HuaHan's postal line, relayed in Chinese: handed to the airline that flies it; read as China Post's map reads it.
The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line: arrived in the destination country.
The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line: arrived at the destination's processing centre.

entries.wording: 境外进口海关留存待验(等待提交给边境机构/安全部门)
entries.note: The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line: held by import customs for inspection, with the reason in brackets.
The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line: kept at the import office of exchange, between customs' hold and the presentation to customs.
The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line: presented to import customs.

entries.wording: 寄达地海关允许进口（无需缴税）
entries.note: The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line: import customs released it, with no duty to pay.
The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line, with the country in 【】: left the processing centre.
The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line: arrived at a transit office abroad.
The destination post's scan as China Post copies it, relayed in Chinese on HuaHan's postal line, with the country in 【】: arrived at the delivery office.
USPS's scan between its facilities, relayed under HuaHan's code for USPS's facility scans, with the facility after the comma left empty.
USPS's scan while the parcel moves on schedule, relayed the same way.
